requirements.title: Test Article Revision
requirements.definition: Revise the Century Spring test blog article according to reviewer feedback, including stronger storytelling introductions, while treating the approximately 1,000-word target as flexible rather than a hard limit.
requirements.boundary_note: Storytelling, added content, and word-count flexibility are acceptance attributes of the same revised article deliverable. Linked reviewer comments may contain additional criteria, but their contents are unavailable.

requirements.title: Landing Page Copy Revision
requirements.definition: Revise the copy on the identified existing landing page according to section-specific directions supplied in the forthcoming brief.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a separate deliverable from the test article and can be assigned, revised, and accepted independently. Rates, effort estimates, deadlines, and anticipated monthly assignment volume are project-management facts and are excluded.

unresolved_candidates.description: The linked article comments and suggested edits are not present in the supplied history and may contain additional independently meaningful acceptance criteria that cannot be safely recovered.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]!

Thank you for checking in. I’ve now finished reviewing your article, and you did excellent work. The writing is strong, though the blog could be improved further by adding a little more storytelling—for example, engaging introductions that break up lengthy informational lists. My team and I left feedback in the article for you to review and incorporate through the relevant edits.

Once you’ve reviewed the comments and made the edits, we’ll be ready to send your test article to our client. We really appreciate the work you’ve done here, and I’m looking forward to receiving the revised version.

Fire&Spark feedback on the article: [URL_001]

Please reach out if you have any questions!

Thanks,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

value_updates.reviewer_feedback: Incorporate the feedback left in the article
value_updates.storytelling_guidance: Add more storytelling, such as engaging introductions that break up lengthy informational lists

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I have great news! Century Spring has reviewed your work and would like to schedule a meeting with you. They want to hear more about your background and share some context about their company and brand. Please tell me whether you’re available for a call this week.

The team also shared feedback and suggested edits for your test article, which are available here: [URL_003]

Let me know if anything is unclear or if you have questions!

In addition to arranging this meeting, my team wants to give you your next copywriting assignment. Rather than creating a blog article this time, you’ll revise the copy on an existing landing page at [URL_004]. I can provide the brief tomorrow. Regarding your rates, approximately how many hours do you anticipate needing for a copy editing project?

Thanks!
